ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.description: AuthenticatedPrincipalRef is an identity assertion emitted by a trusted boundary.

principalId.description: principal_id is never accepted as caller identity from an untrusted body.

sessionId.description: session_id identifies the authenticated session when a session exists.

tenantId.description: tenant_id is the authenticated tenant context.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.AuthenticatedPrin.title: Authenticated Principal Ref

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Cursor.jsonschema.description: Cursor pins an ordered replay or status position without exposing storage internals.

token.description: token is an opaque bounded continuation token.

watermark.description: watermark is the inclusive canonical event watermark observed by the caller.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Cursor.jsonschema.title: Cursor

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SearchCodeRequest.description: SearchCodeRequest searches one immutable generation with bounded pagination.

after.description: after is an opaque continuation within the same immutable generation.

caller.description: caller is untrusted payload identity to cross-check against authenticated context.

generationId.description: generation_id prevents search across a moving generation pointer.

kind.description: kind selects exact, declaration, or reference search.
kind.title: Search Kind

pageSize.description: page_size is bounded before projection work or allocation.

query.description: query is the bounded exact source spelling to find.

sourceId.description: source_id is resolved under authenticated tenant and brain scope.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.SearchCodeRequest.title: Search Code Request

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedIngestio.description: UntrustedIngestionCaller carries body identity only for authenticated-context checks.

requestedPrincipal.description: requested_principal must match the authenticated peer principal and tenant.

requestedSession.description: requested_session must match the authenticated gateway session.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.UntrustedIngestio.title: Untrusted Ingestion Caller
